heroSourceLine: Source: Alpine School District 2026–27 Academic Calendar · Updated July 29, 2026
heroSummary: Most Alpine School District students start Wednesday, August 19, 2026. Kindergarten and PreK have assessment days August 19–24 and begin regular classes August 25. The school year ends Friday, May 28, 2027, a Minimal Day with no PreK. Alpine uses A/B day labels throughout the year, and 2026–27 is the district’s final year before three successor districts begin operating July 1, 2027.
calendarNotes: Most Alpine School District students begin August 19, while K and PreK use an August 19–24 assessment window before their August 25 opening. The calendar assigns an A or B label to every instructional date, with March 10 marked A/B for the high-school ACT date. Fall Break ends October 16, but students remain out October 19 for a staff workday. Thanksgiving includes a PTC Teacher Comp Day on November 25, and Winter Break is followed by a January 4 staff workday before students return January 5. December 18 and May 28 are Minimal Days, and PreK does not attend either date. Spring Break runs April 5–9, with April 5 also marked as a PTC Teacher Comp Day. Alpine School District operates through June 30, 2027, so 2027–28 dates must come from the successor district assigned to each school.

customSections.label: How to Use Alpine’s A/B Calendar
customSections.content: The official PDF labels each instructional date A or B, and Alpine also publishes a live A/B Calendar. The letters identify the school-day rotation; they do not mean school is closed or shortened. March 10, the high-school ACT date, is marked A/B rather than one letter. Use the student’s school schedule to see which classes meet on A days and B days.

customSections.label: Minimal Days and PreK
customSections.content: December 18 and May 28 are Minimal Days, and PreK does not attend. May 28 is also the last day and the end of the fourth term. The district PDF does not list school-specific dismissal times, so families should confirm the schedule with their school.

customSections.label: Planning for 2027–28?
customSections.content: Alpine School District operates schools through June 30, 2027. Aspen Peaks, Lake Mountain, and Timpanogos school districts begin operating July 1. Aspen Peaks and Timpanogos have published official 2027–28 calendar pages; families should first use Alpine’s transition page to confirm which successor district will serve their school. We did not find a verified official Lake Mountain 2027–28 calendar when this page was reviewed.

whatsNew.title: 2026–27 Compared With 2025–26
content: The first day of school is August 19, 2026, compared with August 13 for 2025–26.

K and PreK use an August 19–24 assessment window and begin August 25. In 2025–26, kindergarten assessments ran August 13–18 and kindergarten began August 19; the archived calendar did not publish a PreK first day.
Winter Break starts December 21, one day earlier than the December 22 start in 2025–26. Students return January 5 instead of January 6.
The last day is May 28, 2027, compared with May 22 for the prior school year. Both are Minimal Days.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Alpine School District start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Most students start Wednesday, August 19, 2026. K and PreK assessment days run August 19–24, and the first regular K and PreK day is Tuesday, August 25.

calendarFaqs.q: What are A and B days in Alpine School District?
calendarFaqs.a: A and B identify Alpine's alternating school-day rotation. The official PDF prints the letter for each instructional date, and the district calendar page links a live A/B Calendar. Use the student's school schedule to see which classes meet on A days and B days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Alpine School District Fall Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break is October 15–16, 2026. Students also have no school Monday, October 19 for a staff workday and return Tuesday, October 20.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Alpine School District Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Students remain out January 4 for a staff workday and return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Alpine School District Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, April 5, through Friday, April 9, 2027. April 5 is also a PTC Teacher Comp Day. Students return Monday, April 12.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school in Alpine School District?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day is Friday, May 28, 2027. It is a Minimal Day, the fourth term ends, and PreK does not attend.

calendarFaqs.q: What happens to Alpine School District after 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Alpine School District operates through June 30, 2027. Aspen Peaks, Lake Mountain, and Timpanogos school districts begin operating July 1. Aspen Peaks and Timpanogos have published official 2027–28 calendar pages; use Alpine's transition page to confirm which successor district will serve the student's school.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloadable Alpine calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The MySchoolDates ICS file is a one-time import and does not include daily A/B labels. Use Alpine's live calendars for later changes and the current A/B rotation.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 9, 2026, against Alpine School District's live calendar page and a visually rendered copy of the complete 2026–27 Academic Calendar updated July 29, 2026.
sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we verified the Alpine calendar
sourceReviewDetails: The one-page 2026–27 PDF was board-approved on March 11, 2025, and updated July 29, 2026.

The PDF was rendered and checked visually because the color legend, A/B letters, Minimal Day corners, term endings, and overlapping staff/break labels carry information that text extraction alone does not preserve.
The official calendar page links the same 2026–27 Academic Calendar, a live District Events Calendar, and a separate live A/B Calendar.
K and PreK assessment days are presented as an assigned planning window, not as four ordinary full-attendance days.
The future-year file on Alpine's calendar page is labeled Calendar Recommendations for 2027–28, 2028–29, and 2029–30. It is not treated as an adopted Alpine student calendar.
Alpine's official transition page says the district operates through June 30, 2027, and three successor districts begin July 1.
We checked the official Aspen Peaks and Timpanogos sites for their published 2027–28 calendars. We did not add a Lake Mountain calendar because we did not find a verified official source.
The .ics file is a one-time import and omits daily A/B labels. Previously imported dates do not update automatically.
